svg.title: Taffee target architecture v2: outer and inner loops
svg.text: Agent Orchestrator: the OUTER loop (one per request)
Held to the caller's contract. Decides the outcome.
• Turn the request into a contract
• Split it into tasks (via model router)
Start one agent per task, each in its own sandbox:
INNER loop: the Strands Agent Loop
One per agent. Vendor: Strands. Task contract.
• Agents call context, tools and APIs (credentials
added outside the sandbox) and models via the router
re-plan / redo or add agents / more context
Ways out of the outer loop (decided by 5. Evaluate)
• Needs something only the caller knows → ask them (a clarifying question)
• Budget or time used up → stop with the reason (failed or partial)
Inner loop decides "is my task done?". Outer loop decides "is the request done?".
Only the outer loop sets the outcome.
• Catalog of tools, agents, APIs, MCP servers
• Final answer, or the question to answer, or the reason
• What was verified and what was only judged
• Traces and logs; latency (P50, P95, P99)
• Safety and policy violations; health, SLOs
scores BOTH loops across many runs:
inner = how agents worked, outer = outcomes
feeds prompts, plans and models; sets no outcome
Outer loop: the orchestrator, one per request
round again until satisfied or out of budget.
Held to the caller's contract. Authoritative.
Inner loop: each agent, inside Execute
Call model ⇄ run tools, until its task is done.
Held to its task contract. Advisory.
Each loop evaluates against its own contract.
